title: Tensoring a mapping cone with a complex gives the mapping cone of the tensor map
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal A^\bullet$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O$-modules, and $K_1^\bullet\to K_2^\bullet$ a morphism of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with mapping cone $K_3^\bullet$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then the total tensor complex $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_3^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is naturally isomorphic, as a complex, to the mapping cone of the induced morphism $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_1^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_2^\bullet)$, compatibly with the inclusions of $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_2^\bullet)$.

mathlib_searches.query: an additive tensor bifunctor sends the mapping cone of a complex morphism to the mapping cone of the tensor morphism
